description: This file contains service functions for managing notifications in a gym management system, including listing notifications, marking them as read, creating new notifications, and materializing due reminders. It interacts with database models and schemas, and provides a public API for notification operations.

methods.name: list_for_user
methods.description: Lists notifications for a specific user with optional unread filter and pagination.

methods.name: mark_read
methods.description: Marks a specific notification as read for a user.

methods.name: create_notification
methods.description: Creates a new notification record in the database.

methods.name: materialize_due_reminders
methods.description: Marks scheduled notifications as sent if their scheduled time has arrived.
